span.p:
Each cluster box has its own API server and database (one KMS key), system pool, VNet, Kubernetes version, cluster admin and audit log.
Each zone box has its own subnets, nodes, gateway, namespaces, Key Vault, identities, certificate, PaaS and backups – the same in A, B, C and D.
